name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 8 times in 3 visits over 13 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 18 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 13 hours starting 2026-05-13, at wavelengths from 1.63 to 4.96 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
